# Callouts: Recovery 1.2 - the pull-down on each strap pad (ohms)

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec1-2_pulldown-ohms.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec1-2_pulldown-ohms.jpg)

Resistance to GND. The black lead stays on U15 pin 4; the red lead goes on each strap pad in turn; wait until the reading settles. About 2.7 kOhm = SOP2, about 100 kOhm = SOP0 or SOP1.
